recap: Nifty 50 ended at 25,349.65 (-1.75%) and the Sensex at 82,435.99 (-1.77%); Bank Nifty moved -3.17%.
By size: large caps (Nifty 100) -1.67%, mid caps (Midcap 150) -0.92%, small caps (Smallcap 250) -0.69%.
FIIs were net buyers of ₹5,673 cr and DIIs net sellers of ₹2,760 cr (provisional, NSE).
IT led the sectors (+1.69%), while Metal lagged (-3.68%).
Top Nifty 500 gainer was TCS (+3.53%); biggest faller was TATASTEEL (-8.43%). Breadth: 11 advances vs 38 declines.
Overseas, the S&P 500 last closed up 4.73% and the Nasdaq up 6.51%.
The rupee is at 92.90 per dollar, Brent at $86.73 (-6.31%) and gold at $3,635 (+3.39%).
